name: NeerSoft AI Content Coverage
author: Ritesh Sharma

sections.description:
Your SEO plugin tells you what keyword to optimize for. NeerSoft AI Content Coverage tells you what related questions your content should answer.

NeerSoft AI Content Coverage is a lightweight add-on that works alongside Rank Math SEO, Yoast SEO, or SEOPress. It reads the focus keyword you’ve already set in one of those plugins (or a keyword you enter manually), and uses your own OpenAI or Google Gemini API key to:

  1. Generate a set of potential AI-search fan-out queries: related subquestions a person might ask an AI search engine (such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, or Perplexity) around your focus keyword.
  2. Analyze how well your current page content already answers each one.
  3. Show a 0-100 coverage score per query, a red/yellow/green status, a short explanation, and a suggested improvement.
  4. Roll all of that up into a single overall Fan-Out Coverage Score.

NeerSoft AI Content Coverage does not replace your SEO plugin, does not write or modify your content automatically, and does not guarantee any Google AI Overview or ChatGPT citation – it is a content-planning aid, not an official search-engine ranking system.

Bring your own AI API key

You supply your own OpenAI or Google Gemini API key. AI requests are billed directly by your selected provider according to that provider’s pricing and terms. NeerSoft AI Content Coverage / NeerSoft never sees, stores, or proxies your API key – it is encrypted at rest in your WordPress database and used only for direct calls from your server to the provider you chose.

How it works

  1. Set a focus keyword in Rank Math, Yoast SEO, or SEOPress as you normally would (or type one directly into the NeerSoft AI Content Coverage panel if none of those plugins are active).
  2. Open the “GEO/AEO Optimize” panel in the post/page editor sidebar.
  3. Click “GEO/AEO Optimize” to generate 10-20 potential fan-out queries and analyze your current content against them.
  4. Review the coverage score, red/yellow/green status, and suggested improvements for each query.
  5. Edit your page, then click “Re-analyze Coverage” to re-score the same query set – or “Regenerate Queries” for a fresh set.

Features

  • Reads the focus keyword already set in Rank Math, Yoast SEO, or SEOPress – or accepts one typed in manually.
  • Generates 10-20 potential AI-search fan-out queries per page using your own OpenAI or Google Gemini API key.
  • Scores each query 0-100 for how well your current content covers it, with a red/yellow/green status.
  • Overall Fan-Out Coverage Score for the page.
  • Short, specific improvement suggestions for weakly-covered queries.
  • User-confirmable “mark as covered” checkboxes.
  • Re-analyze the existing query set without a new generation call, or regenerate a fresh set on demand.
  • Works in both the block editor (Gutenberg) and the Classic Editor.
  • No AI request is ever made without you explicitly clicking a button – nothing runs automatically or on a schedule.
  • No tracking, no analytics, no telemetry, no NeerSoft account required.

Supported SEO Plugins

  • Rank Math SEO (reads the rank_math_focus_keyword meta)
  • Yoast SEO (reads the Focus Keyphrase)
  • SEOPress (reads the primary Target Keyword)
  • None of the above? Type a seed keyword directly into the NeerSoft AI Content Coverage panel.

NeerSoft AI Content Coverage is an independent, compatible add-on. It is not an official Rank Math, Yoast, or SEOPress product, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by those companies.

AI Providers

  • OpenAI (Chat Completions API)
  • Google Gemini (Generative Language API)

Configure your provider, model, and API key under Settings -> NeerSoft AI Content Coverage. You can test your connection before saving.

Privacy

NeerSoft AI Content Coverage sends data to your selected AI provider only when you explicitly click “GEO/AEO Optimize,” “Re-analyze Coverage,” “Regenerate Queries,” or “Test API Connection.” Nothing is sent automatically, on a schedule, or on page load.

Data that may be sent to the AI provider you selected:

  • Your focus keyword / seed keyword
  • The current page’s title, headings, and main content text (capped in length)
  • Relevant image ALT text

Data that is never sent anywhere by this plugin:

  • WordPress passwords or authentication credentials
  • Your API key(s) to any destination other than the provider you selected them for
  • Content from other posts, pages, drafts, or users
  • WooCommerce orders, comments, or other unrelated site/customer data

Your API key is encrypted at rest in the WordPress database and is never sent to NeerSoft, never included in page HTML, and never exposed to site visitors.

NeerSoft AI Content Coverage also registers suggested language with WordPress’s built-in Privacy Policy tool (Settings -> Privacy) that you can add to your site’s privacy policy.

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party AI APIs only when you initiate an action (Generate, Re-analyze, Regenerate, or Test Connection). It does not run these requests automatically, on a schedule, or in the background.

OpenAI (if selected as your provider)
Sends: your focus keyword and, for coverage analysis, page title/headings/content, to https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions.
Terms of use: https://openai.com/policies/row-terms-of-use/
Privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Google Gemini (if selected as your provider)
Sends: your focus keyword and, for coverage analysis, page title/headings/content, to https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/.
Terms of use: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Only the provider you select in Settings receives any data. NeerSoft AI Content Coverage / NeerSoft does not operate a proxy or intermediary service and does not receive your API key or your content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/neersoft-ai-content-coverage, or install the ZIP directly via Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings -> NeerSoft AI Content Coverage and add an API key for OpenAI and/or Google Gemini, then click Test API Connection.
  4. Open a post or page, set a focus keyword in your SEO plugin (or enter one manually in the NeerSoft AI Content Coverage panel), and click GEO/AEO Optimize.
sections.faq:
Does this replace Rank Math, Yoast, or SEOPress?

No. NeerSoft AI Content Coverage reads the focus keyword those plugins already store and adds a separate content-coverage analysis on top. It never modifies another plugin’s settings or data.

Do I need a NeerSoft account?

No. You bring your own OpenAI or Google Gemini API key. NeerSoft AI Content Coverage never contacts NeerSoft servers and never sees or stores your key anywhere but your own encrypted WordPress database.

Will this guarantee my page appears in Google AI Overviews or gets cited by ChatGPT?

No. No tool can guarantee that. NeerSoft AI Content Coverage is a content-planning aid that shows you related questions an AI search engine might generate around your keyword, and how completely your current content answers them. Treat the score as a coverage checklist, not a ranking signal.

What data gets sent to the AI provider?

When you click Generate, Re-analyze, or Test Connection, the plugin sends your focus keyword and, for coverage analysis, the current page’s title, headings, and main text content to the AI provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini) you selected. Nothing is sent automatically – only in direct response to your click. See the Privacy section below for full detail.

Does it work with the Classic Editor?

Yes. The NeerSoft AI Content Coverage panel is a standard WordPress meta box, so it appears in both the block editor (in the Document sidebar, below the built-in panels) and the Classic Editor.

How many queries does it generate?

10-20, configurable in Settings (default 12).
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Rank Math, Yoast SEO, and SEOPress focus-keyword detection, with manual fallback.
  • OpenAI and Google Gemini providers, with connection testing.
  • AI-generated potential fan-out queries with categorization and deduplication.
  • Per-query and overall Fan-Out Coverage Score with red/yellow/green status.
  • Content-gap recommendations and user-confirmable coverage checkboxes.
  • Re-analyze and Regenerate actions.
  • Works in both the block editor and the Classic Editor.
